attachments.origin_landmark: costal cartilages 7-12, thoracolumbar fascia, iliac crest, lateral inguinal ligament
attachments.insertion_landmark: linea alba (via aponeurosis) and pubic crest; lowest fibers contribute to the conjoint tendon

actions: compresses abdominal contents / raises intra-abdominal pressure
feedforward stabilization of the lumbar spine preceding limb movement

functional_compartments.name: Single fiber population
functional_compartments.function_note: Deepest of the three flat abdominal layers; fibers run purely horizontally (transversely), distinct from both overlying oblique layers -- functionally the primary intrinsic spinal stabilizer of the group, with well-documented feedforward (anticipatory) activation before limb movement.
functional_compartments.source: Hodges PW, Richardson CA (1996) Spine 21(22):2640-2650 -- transversus abdominis's role in lumbar spine stabilization (feedforward activation preceding limb movement)

source: Gray's Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake, Vogl, Mitchell); Terminologia Anatomica (FICAT 1998); Hodges PW, Richardson CA (1996) Spine 21(22):2640-2650 -- transversus abdominis's role in lumbar spine stabilization (feedforward activation preceding limb movement)
